home.tagline: Job checklists your technicians can actually finish
home.subtitle: Create a checklist, share one link with the technician — no account needed on their side — and get a signed-off PDF report when the work is done.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to run a job end to end
home.feature1Desc: Attach a photo or video to every checklist item, straight from the camera.
home.feature2Desc: Share one link — the technician works through the checklist with no account required.
home.feature3Desc: Both sides sign off before a job is marked complete, with a PDF report generated automatically.
home.feature4Desc: Full interface translation in English, Arabic, Sinhala, Urdu, and Hindi — with proper right-to-left layout.
home.feature5Desc: Photograph what needs fixing and let AI turn it into a checklist item automatically.
home.heroNote: Free to start · No app install for technicians
home.highlight1Desc: Short, easy to read aloud or type — rate-limited so it stays secure.
home.highlight2Desc: Send the job straight to the technician's WhatsApp, no compose screen.
home.highlight3Desc: Manager and technician sign off, and a PDF is generated automatically.
home.stepsTitle: From checklist to signed-off job in three steps
home.step1Desc: Add items by hand, or photograph what needs fixing and let AI turn it into a checklist item for you.
home.step1Bullet1: Type items or generate them from a photo
home.step1Bullet2: Set a flat job price and the technician's phone number
home.step2Desc: Share a short 6-character link over WhatsApp or however you like — the technician needs no account and no app install.
home.step2Bullet1: Opens straight to WhatsApp with the technician's number
home.step2Bullet2: Works in the technician's own language automatically
home.step3Desc: The technician checks off each item, attaches a confirmation photo, and both sides sign off before the job is marked complete.
home.step3Bullet1: Photo or video evidence on every item
home.step3Bullet2: Auto-generated PDF report once signed off
home.faq1Q: Does the technician need to install an app?
home.faq1A: No. They open the share link in any phone browser — no account, no download.
home.faq2A: The full interface is available in English, Arabic, Sinhala, Urdu, and Hindi, including right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu.
home.faq3Q: Can I set a price for the job?
home.faq3A: Yes — set one flat AED price per job rather than per item, so you categorize work the way you actually price it.
home.faq4A: Share the link over WhatsApp, and if you've added their phone number it opens a chat with them directly.
home.faq5A: GetItDone is free to use while it's in early access.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to ditch the paper checklist?
home.ctaSubtitle: Create your first job in under a minute — no credit card required.
home.footerTagline: Job checklists your technicians can actually finish.
